mechanism.summary: Move CallEnv state needed only by dynamic scope, constructors, private names, and module live bindings into an on-demand copy-on-write cold block while retaining the hot realm, frame-binding, and module-routing fields inline.
mechanism.generality: The representation is selected only by whether JavaScript execution actually introduces one of the corresponding language states. It does not inspect workload names, source paths, function identities, call depth, input values, iterations, or results. Every frame, including direct eval, constructors, generators, modules, native callbacks, and ordinary direct calls, continues through the same CallEnv API and semantics.
semantic_risks: preserving per-frame versus inherited ownership and copy-on-write isolation of catch bindings, direct-eval conflicts, deoptimization cells, and immutable function names
preserving new.target, private-environment, direct-eval with-stack, and module live-binding lookup and mutation ordering
preserving native-call and direct-eval compatibility snapshots, including visible frame bindings and writeback behavior
preserving error, throw, finally, generator, async, and module suspension paths that materialize cold state after frame entry
ensuring a cold-state allocation never changes ordinary realm lookup, slot-authority, or direct-leaf fallback behavior
